metas.name: 1 · ★ 4.8 · 1993 · Leprechaun
metas.description: An evil, sadistic Leprechaun goes on a killing rampage in search of his beloved pot of gold.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.7 · 1994 · Leprechaun 2
metas.description: On his one thousandth birthday, an evil leprechaun selects the descendant of one of his slaves to have as his bride, leaving it up to the girl's boyfriend to save her.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 3.2 · 2014 · Leprechaun: Origins
metas.description: Not related to the previous Leprechaun films. Two young couples backpacking through Ireland discover that one of Ireland's most famous legends is a terrifying reality.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.0 · 2018 · Leprechaun Returns
metas.description: The Leprechaun returns once again, when a group of girls unwillingly awaken him after they tear down a cabin so that they can build a new sorority house.
